title: Quality Sidecar Bridge Request
description: Request the JGates core sends to `python -m quality_sidecar bridge`. Local mode only: governed mode is always refused.

outputDir.description: Absolute folder for reports, raw evidence and scope projections.

mode.description: governed is accepted by the schema only so it can be refused with a structured error.

subchecks.description: Subchecks to run. A subcheck left out does not run (file-size out means budgets disabled). Absent: every subcheck the mode and the flags turn on.

hardened.description: The governed CI path (jgates ci): MegaLinter runs only the linters megalinter-linters.json does not exclude, with their forcing arguments, and MEGALINTER_COMMAND is ignored. Never combined with toolConfigs.

toolConfigs.description: Local mode only: the project configuration file each scanner uses instead of the trusted package file. Relative to target (or absolute); it must stay inside target, symlinks followed, and exist.
